title: Maccuɗo Hakkille Suuɗiiɗo
intro: E nder tappirde yaajnde e daartol Quraan, ina darii mbaydi teskinndi, maccuɗo Alla mo ganndal e yurmeende Alla. Oo neɗɗo sirlu taƴti laabi e gooto e annabaaɓe ɓurɓe mawnude, ardi e laawol keewngol golle muusɗe, luulndiiɗe keeri faamde aadee. Kala gollal, hay so ina nanndi e ko fotaani, ina suuɗii janngirɗe luggiɗe ko fayti e hoddiro, muñal, e hakkille mo yiyaaka caggal yamiroore Alla. Hol ooɗoo mbaydi ɓuuɓndi, hol goongaaji ɗi ɓe peeñnini ?
clues: Ko mi maccuɗo Alla, cuɓaaɗo ngam ganndal keewngal e yurmeende.
Annabi mawɗo yiɗiino janngude e am, mi jaɓii e sarɗiiji tiiɗɗi.
E nder pottital amen, mi waɗii golle tati ɗe nanndaani e sehil am.
Mi bonnii laana jeyaaka e miskineeɓe, tee ko yurmeende suuɗnde.
Mi ƴettii nguurndam suka gorko, hay so ina wayi no ko fenaande, ko ngam hisnude jibnaaɓe mum sunaare.
Mi mahii mahdi e nder wuro ngo haɗi en jaɓɓaade, ina feeñnina ngalu les mum.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Kawral Annabi Muusa to kawtal maayo ɗiɗo
Mahde damal ngam haɓaade Gog e Magog
Feccere maayo ngoo e feccere ɗiɗi
trial.answer: Kawral Annabi Muusa to kawtal maayo ɗiɗo

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: O faamnini hakkille Alla caggal golle makko muusɗe, o seerti e Muusaa
O rokkaa annabaagal caggal yahdu nduu
O mahii jumaa e nder wuro ngo alaa ɗo haaɗi
outcome.answer: O faamnini hakkille Alla caggal golle makko muusɗe, o seerti e Muusaa

arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًۭا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًۭا
verse: And they found a servant from among Our servants [i.e., al-Khiḍr] to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge. (18:65)
